title: HB1535 (2024 Regular Session): Modifies the offense of unlawful possession of a firearm to include any minor possessing a firearm on public property

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text: Section 571.070 (RSMo): A person commits the offense of unlawful possession of a firearm if such person knowingly has any firearm in his or her possession and: Such person is under eighteen years of age and is on public property. However, possession under this subdivision is not an offense if such person possesses the firearm: While accompanied by a person twenty-one years of age or older; For the purposes of a school-sanctioned, firearm-related event or club event; For the lawful pursuit of game; or As otherwise authorized by law.
